name: Onesiphorus
overview: Onesiphorus is a male figure noted in Scripture for his encouragement and support of the Apostle Paul during a time of imprisonment. He is uniquely recognized for refreshing Paul and demonstrating boldness by not being ashamed of Paul's chains, highlighting his faithful companionship in adversity.
namesAndTitles: The name Onesiphorus appears only once in the provided data and carries no recorded meaning or divine origin. Therefore, his name is simply a proper name without further specified significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Onesiphorus beyond what is mentioned in his unique attribute of supporting Paul. No additional familial or relational details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Onesiphorus is significant in the biblical narrative as a faithful supporter of Paul during his imprisonment, exemplifying courage and loyalty. His actions of refreshing Paul and not being ashamed of his chains underscore the Christian virtue of steadfastness in suffering for the gospel. This character serves as a model of encouragement and solidarity in the face of persecution.
